entries.question: मेरे बाल टूट रहे हैं उसका इलाज कराना है
entries.answer:
बालों के झड़ने के इलाज के लिए, आपको किसी त्वचा विशेषज्ञ (dermatologist) से सलाह लेनी चाहिए। वे आपके बालों के झड़ने के कारण का पता लगा सकते हैं और उचित उपचार की सिफारिश कर सकते हैं।

आप KGMU में त्वचा विज्ञान विभाग (Department of Dermatology) से संपर्क कर सकते हैं। वे आपकी मदद कर सकते हैं।

यहां त्वचा विज्ञान विभाग का लिंक दिया गया है: [https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=12&dept_type=2](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=12&dept_type=2)

entries.question: Hospital registration number
entries.answer:
You can find information related to OPD services and registration on the KGMU website. Online registration is mandatory for all patients.

You can book appointments through the following methods:
*   **Website:** www.ors.gov.in
*   **Phone:** 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333
*   **SMS:** Send "APPOINTMENT <NAME>" to 8887019134

For medical consultation, you can also use the e-Sanjeevani app or visit www.esanjeevani.opd.in.

entries.question: How can I fix an appointment with ENT Department on Tuesday?
entries.answer:
You can fix an appointment with the ENT Department by visiting the OPD registration counter at the hospital between 8:30 AM and 11:45 AM on weekdays. Alternatively, you can book an appointment online through www.ors.gov.in, by calling 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333, or by sending an SMS with "APPOINTMENT <NAME>" to 8887019134.

For more information about OPD services, you can visit: https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_type=2&dept_id=23&page_type=out_patient_services
